content.text:
I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). The code that splits text into paragraphs was correct, but `wrap_text` put the wrapped paragraphs back together with a single `"
"`. That dropped the blank line between paragraphs, so `"a

b"` came out as `"a
b"`. I changed the final join to `"

"`. Runs of several blank lines still collapse into one paragraph break, as the tests expect. I made one more change the tests didn't ask for: a line containing only spaces or tabs now counts as a paragraph break (the check is `not line.strip()` instead of `line == ""`). Before, a line like `"  "` was silently ignored and the paragraphs on either side were merged; if that merging was intended, this part should be reverted.
